title: The Wolf and the Lion and the Shepherd
summary: A wolf stole a sheep from the shepherd, only to meet a lion who seized the prize. The shepherd watched from afar, seeing justice done between thieves....
keywords: the wolf and the lion and the shepherd
full_text:
In the sunlit pastures of ancient Greece, where olive groves swayed gently against the mountain breeze, A wolf stole a sheep from the shepherd, only to meet a lion who seized the prize. The shepherd watched from afar, seeing justice done between thieves..... The creatures of the field went about their daily lives according to their nature, each seeking their own advantage while keeping a vigilant watch over friends and foes alike.

As the hours passed, an unexpected turning point arose that tested their wits and character. A tense confrontation soon arose as rival desires crossed paths under the midday sun. Words were exchanged with cautious cunning, glances were measured, and each party sought to disguise their true intentions behind a veil of outward innocence.

Yet the timeless laws of nature cannot be deceived by clever words or false appearances. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax.  The outcome was swift and irreversible, leaving behind a lasting lesson for all who witnessed the event, proving that the predator who steals from the fold is easily stripped by the stronger beast.
moral: The predator who steals from the fold is easily stripped by the stronger beast.
